storage medium

  • CURIE: gmeow:storageMedium
  • IRI: https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/storageMedium
  • Category: property
  • Defined by: gmeow:slices/places

The medium of a storage location (a gmeow:StorageMedium individual). Functional: the medium is constitutive of the storage location (a different medium is a different store) — unlike the descriptive, multi-source gmeow:placeType.

Structure

Property shape: object property; gmeow:StorageLocation -> gmeow:StorageMedium; functional

Practical Pattern

Use gmeow:storageMedium from gmeow:StorageLocation to gmeow:StorageMedium when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.

Common Companion Terms

gmeow:StorageLocation, gmeow:StorageMedium
